title: Enqueue the pin PR via the merge-queue mutation
body:
## Summary

Enqueue the pin PR via the merge-queue mutation instead of `gh pr merge --auto`, and poll for the gated `pull_request` runs before approving them.

Two findings from the live publishes:

1. **#23**: `--auto` only set the `auto_merge` flag (`enabled_by: github-actions[bot]`, `merge_method: merge`) but never added the PR to the merge queue — no `merge_group` run, queue entries empty, PR sat open with all checks green. The explicit `enqueuePullRequest` GraphQL mutation is what adds a PR to the queue. Since it also requires every required check green on the head sha, it is retried for ~10 minutes and `--auto` remains the last-resort fallback.
2. **#25**: the one-shot `gh run list --status action_required` immediately after `gh pr create` found no gated runs — they are created asynchronously — so the approval was skipped and the runs still sat awaiting a maintainer. The approval now polls for up to five minutes: bail early after three empty polls when no gated run ever appeared, and stop two polls after the last approval so late-arriving runs are still caught.

This changes runtime behavior: the pin PR is now actually enqueued into the merge queue and its gated CI/lint runs are reliably self-approved.

None.
